title: A forward carries the original's files
steps: On a test account, open a message you sent yourself with a PDF attached
Press f, address it to your own test address and remove nothing
Send it, then open the forward in Sent
Forward the same message again and remove the PDF before sending
expected: The forward draft shows the PDF as an attachment tile under the quoted original. The sent forward contains the PDF and the forwarded message text. The second forward goes out with the quote and no attachment.
